review_scope: CP-B EEG only; independent delegated AI evidence review

reviewer.actual_dispatch_verification: Parent confirms explicit spawn_agent model=gpt-6-astra, reasoning_effort=xhigh, fork_turns=none. Spawn response did not provide a separately resolved runtime receipt; actual runtime model/effort independently unverified.
reviewer.authorization: Parent reports user delegated checkpoint decisions to agents; this record is AI review evidence, not manufactured human signoff.

decision_semantics.accept: Retain existing automated signal eligibility and its epoch exclusions for exploratory descriptive features; acceptance does not certify cortical origin. Timebase decisions remain separate.
decision_semantics.reject: Exclude the current channel summary for the stated evidence; no invented replacement mask or repair. Trial rejection concerns bilateral combination and does not override accepted separate channels.
decision_semantics.uncertain: Evidence does not resolve the current summary; keep ineligible for reviewed physiology unless a subsequent documented review resolves it.

limitations: This is an AI review, not a credentialed physiological assessment or human-owner signature.
Every trial/channel metric record was examined, but only the listed panels/windows were visually inspected; no claim that all panels or all epochs were viewed.
Raw sample rate, physical amplitude units, reference wiring and contact measurements remain unverified. All temporal and spectral readings use conditional 500 Hz.
Artifact descriptions are visual inferences; specific hardware fault, electrode contact or biological source is not verified.
Thresholds are operational screeners. Low line-noise/muscle ratios cannot establish cortical validity; slow eye/movement transients can remain in accepted forehead signals.
Generated supplemental whole-trial figures plot every sample, but display resolution limits visual detail. Only selected epochs have full-resolution trace/spectrum inspection.
No ratings, affect results, correlations or model scores were used to select dispositions.
No automatic mask, numerical threshold, raw signal or EEG feature was changed by this review.

coverage.rare_non_EEG_and_timebase_dispositions: Outside this reviewer scope; reviewed by delegated cardiac/timebase reviewer.
